rv.q: Lucy Ireland and Jim Manganello direct a superbly sharp staging of Enda Walsh’s 2016 teaser
It results in a highly theatrical piece of theatre, where the vision is often the medium through which the narrative is driven.
So much of the production is so impressive that it is a shame that it wobbles a little towards the end, but the overall effect is still very fine.
Shotput Theatre ’s production blends the physical, the distorted and the hope we have as humanity into a haunting exploration of connection and survival.
